cards.name: Shove
cards.text: Shove an enemy next to you a tile back and spin it round: its back is to you. What it queued still goes off, from where it lands. Into a wall or a unit it takes a knock. Strong arms shove two tiles.

cards.name: Flank Step
cards.text: Slip up to two tiles, no AP, and turn to the nearest enemy you see: get round to its side or back before you strike.

cards.name: Yank
cards.text: Yank a seen enemy within 3 tiles a tile toward you. What it has planned still goes off, from where it lands.

cards.name: Spoil
cards.text: Break the next action of a seen enemy within 4 tiles, if it has not gone off by the time this comes up.

cards.name: Drag In
cards.text: Drag an enemy within 3 tiles two tiles toward you: into your reach, or onto a blow already coming down. Breaks its strike.

cards.name: Switch Places
cards.text: Trade places with an ally within 2 tiles: pull them out of a blow and take their tile, or put your fighter up front.

cards.name: Go Now!
cards.text: An ally is hurried along: everything it does this round comes up sooner.

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: A seen enemy is held up: everything it does this round comes up later.

cards.name: Barricade
cards.text: Throw up cover on an open tile next to you, for this round and the next.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.text: A smoke screen over a seen tile within 5 and the tiles round it (not over yourself), for this round and the next: nobody sees or shoots through it, or into it from further than a step.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.text: You or an ally within 2 tiles gets 1 AP more this turn.

cards.name: Snap Strike
cards.text: Strike an enemy in reach now with your best attack, for no AP. Fighters only.

cards.name: Dash
cards.text: One more tile of move range this turn. Spend 1 AP for another.

cards.name: Sprint
cards.text: Two more tiles of move range. Runners only.

cards.name: Steady Aim
cards.text: +10% to hit on your next attack; more for trained shooters.

cards.name: Heavy Swing
cards.text: +10% to hit on your next attack. Needs working arms. 1 AP more for another 10%.

cards.name: Called Shot
cards.text: +25% to hit on your next attack, for 1 AP. Marksmen only; needs working arms.

cards.name: Parry
cards.text: Guard your tile or the one next to you this round: any hit there is half as bad, whoever stands on it.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.text: Guard the three tiles in front of you this round. Turn it as you like.

cards.name: Hold the Gap
cards.text: Guard a line of three tiles within 2 tiles this round. Turn it as you like.

cards.name: Sweep
cards.text: Swing your melee weapon across the three tiles in front of you. Anyone there is struck, friends too.

cards.name: Lunge
cards.text: Drive your melee weapon through the two tiles ahead. Anyone there is struck, friends too.

cards.name: Bull Rush
cards.text: Drive everyone on the three tiles in front of you back 2 tiles. Friends too.

cards.name: Rushing Strike
cards.text: Dash up to 3 tiles straight, then swing across the three tiles in front of you, surer for the run-up. Friends there are struck too.

cards.name: Forced March
cards.text: Plan a second move this round.

cards.name: Press On
cards.text: One more action this round, with the AP for it.

cards.name: Quick Reflex
cards.text: One more action this round, for no AP or stamina.

cards.name: Quick Hands
cards.text: Play another card this round.

cards.name: War Cry
cards.text: Work yourself up: +25 adrenaline.

cards.name: Hook Cut
cards.text: A wide hooking cut: the three tiles in front and the one beyond. Anyone there is struck, friends too.

cards.name: Take Cover
cards.text: +15% cover until your next turn.

cards.name: Roll With It
cards.text: The next hit you take lands a tier lighter.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.text: The next hit you take lands two tiers lighter. Tough fighters only.

cards.name: Field Dressing
cards.text: Takes 10% off your worst injury; more in trained hands. Used up.

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.text: Draw two cards.

cards.name: Sidestep
cards.text: The next hit you take lands a tier lighter, and one more tile of move range.

cards.name: Counterstrike
cards.text: A free strike at a seen enemy in reach, as quick as any blow, on top of what you have planned.
